summary.note: Both digests contained only obfuscated redirect URLs (beehiiv / Substack) with generic 'Link N' titles and no article text. Downstream wiki-ingest cannot resolve these without a scraping step that unwraps redirects; beehiiv links returned 403 to curl.

classifications.subject: 🚨 AI 2027 Authors Now Expect 2027 Takeoff
classifications.why: AI 2027 is a tracked, high-signal source for AGI timeline forecasting (Daniel Kokotajlo et al.). A headline shift to '2027 takeoff' is a material update to existing timeline/forecasting wiki pages and likely warrants an events/ page plus updates to any AGI-timeline and forecasting concept pages.
suggested_wiki_actions: Resolve the 20 beehiiv redirect URLs via the email HTML (raw_path only stored redirect shells) before scraping
Create/update events/ page for the AI 2027 timeline revision
Cross-reference forecasting/AGI-timeline concept pages; record prior expectation vs new claim with date + source
If author commentary (Kokotajlo) present, update relevant entity page
classifications.blocked_on: URL resolution — redirect unwrapping required; links are not directly fetchable

classifications.subject: The Dark Edition of my new book is now available on Amazon!
classifications.why: Self-promotional book-launch announcement from AI Weekly. The digest body is almost entirely Substack chrome (like/comment/share/app-link redirects, tokenized post URLs). No substantive technical content about LLMs or agents is present in the stored raw file.
suggested_wiki_actions: Optionally record the author/book only if AI Weekly's author is already a tracked entity

followups: newsletter-ingest stores un-unwrapped beehiiv/Substack redirect URLs with placeholder titles ('Link 1'..'Link N'). Recommend process_email.py capture anchor text and unwrap redirect Location headers (with a proper User-Agent / OAuth context where possible) so triage can classify without guessing.
If AI 2027 digest is pursued, the original email HTML must be re-fetched from the IMAP server (subject '<20261111.190720.a2c7916f@mta16>') — the raw markdown on disk is insufficient.
